name: HoldForge
description: Silicate to native hold: warning-only compatibility checks, partial recordings and optional verification.

offset-ms.name: Timing offset (ms)
offset-ms.description: Positive = later. Nonzero time offset uses approximate editor timeline positions, including when a recording is loaded.

x-offset.name: Position offset
x-offset.description: Move generated Options by this X distance. Recorded paths give a warning when an offset is applied.

max-triggers.name: Object count warning threshold
max-triggers.description: Warn when the generated object count exceeds this number. Does not cancel creation. Native group ID capacity still applies.

backup-level.name: Backup before import
backup-level.description: Save the raw level string before inserting a batch. Backup I/O errors give a warning; the batch still has one Undo.

manual-duals.name: Manual dual sections
manual-duals.description: Ordinary dual: enable both controls at entry, skip macro gates inside, restore state at exit. Build dual objects yourself. Uses available recorded boundaries; if unavailable, creates Options with a warning. Overrides Invisible dual auto.

dual-auto.name: Invisible dual auto (beta)
dual-auto.description: Generate hidden native portals along available recorded P2 positions. Partial recordings and P1 overlap give warnings. If helpers cannot be built, Options are still created and the omission is reported. No effect in Two Player Mode.

shared-p1-only.name: Diagnostic: shared P1 gates only
shared-p1-only.description: Native alternative for ordinary dual: leave property 199 unchanged. Not a confirmed dual fix. Regenerate and Verify to compare. Two Player Mode keeps independent gates.

debug-enabled.name: Enable diagnostic journal
debug-enabled.description: Write bounded event logs plus last-stage.json for crash diagnosis. Previous startup checkpoint survives restart and is included in Export logs.

debug-inputs.name: Log decoded macro inputs
debug-inputs.description: Frame, input type, player, press/release and TPS. Re-import the macro after enabling.

debug-mapping.name: Log time-to-position mapping
debug-mapping.description: Record each generated frame/time/X/P1/P2 and the editor timeline roundtrip.

debug-runtime.name: Trace playtest inputs and triggers
debug-runtime.description: Record input, triggers, dual transitions and damage callbacks/results. A callback does not prove death or detect noclip. Adds logging overhead.

debug-objects.name: Include generated object strings
debug-objects.description: Include serialization in mapping events. Requires Log time-to-position mapping.

debug-mods.name: Include mod versions
debug-mods.description: Record installed mod IDs, versions and loaded state for compatibility diagnosis. Captured when importing.

debug-max-events.name: Diagnostic event limit
debug-max-events.description: Report retains the newest N events. Crash journal writes the first N events of the session. Oldest ring entries are counted as dropped.
